Hello! I am a third-year PhD student in the Department of Statistics at Rice University. I moved to Houston after graduating with my Bachelor's degree from Baylor University in Spring 2024.

I've always been a curious person, and statistics is a powerful instrument for uncovering relationships and exploring the unanswered questions of this world. My time at Rice has deepened these curiosities, while giving me a strong theoretical foundation.

Working with my advisor, [Dr. Meng Li](https://meng.rice.edu), my research develops Bayesian methods for variable and model selection and studies the theoretical properties of ensembles, with applications in medicine and finance.
:::
:::::

If I'm not modeling or dreaming of statistics, I like to cook with my wife, Sarah, or play a board game with some friends. I love playing [tennis](https://calebskinner1.github.io/Tennis-GOAT/), watching [football](https://calebskinner.shinyapps.io/fantasy-dashboard/), and on Sunday morning, you'll find me at my church, Sojourn Montrose. I grew up in Phoenix, Arizona and will always agree to a desert hike. 🌵

For more information, check out my [GitHub](https://github.com/CalebSkinner1), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/calebskinner1), and [CV](skinner_cv.pdf). Please feel free to reach out to me at caleb.skinner\@rice.edu!
